XRP，1.3904，跌1.081%，正一步步蹭向1.37。前几天追高的朋友，现在应该在复盘人生。

方向给明白：空头信号明显。BTC压在轴心79374.23下方运行，下一道考验就是78337.67。守住，顶多继续磨；失守，午后剧本会很难看。哪天收复79374.23，哪天再来谈风向反转。

最后送一句：贴着地板的币不是便宜，是还没探到底。

title: Build a System, Not a Guess.
subTitle:
After 180 days of learning, one truth becomes clearer: Successful investing isn't about getting every prediction right. It's about having a process you can repeat.
A system helps you decide:
🔹 What you invest in
🔹 Why you invest
🔹 How much you allocate
🔹 What risks you accept
🔹 When you review your thesis
🔹 What would make you change your mind
🔹 How you protect your capital
Without a system, every market move becomes a new decision. And when emotions enter the picture, fear and greed can easily take control. With a system, you have a framework to return to.
🔑 Key Takeaway; Don't build your investment strategy around what you think the market will do tomorrow. Build it around how you will respond to whatever the market does.
🧠 Practical Reflection: Take a piece of paper and complete these five sentences:
I invest because…
I will only invest in assets that…
I will never risk more than…
I will reconsider an investment when…
My long-term goal is…
You are beginning to turn your beliefs into a system.
🌱 Thought for the Day. Predictions try to control the future. Systems prepare you for it. Don't chase certainty. Build a process strong enough to operate under uncertainty.
Systems over emotion. Conviction over noise.

Quantum computing is not an immediate threat to Ethereum, but the network is already preparing for a future where today’s cryptography may not be strong enough.

❥ Accounts: Ethereum is working toward making it easier to move accounts to stronger signature systems.

❥ ZK systems: The network is preparing its proof infrastructure for a post-quantum environment.

This is not about fixing an attack that is happening today.

Beyond the Hype: Analyzing PEPE’s Market Dynamics & Deflationary Mechanics

The meme coin sector often gets dismissed as pure speculative hype but PEPE has managed to cement itself alongside Dogecoin and Shiba Inu as a liquidity heavy meme asset. Understanding what drives PEPE's price action requires looking past social media noise and evaluating its core mechanics, holder distribution, and market placement.

PEPE operates on an ERC-20 framework with a maximum total supply of 420.69 trillion tokens. Unlike inflationary tokens that continuously emit new supply, PEPE utilizes a native burn mechanism designed to reduce circulating supply over time. Every transaction burns a small percentage, gradually reducing available supply while its zero buy and sell transaction tax structure keeps trading friction low, making it attractive for high volume traders and arbitrage liquidity.

PEPE also acts as a high-beta liquid proxy for overall market risk tolerance. When major assets like Ethereum experience bullish momentum, capital rapidly flows into PEPE due to its deep liquidity across exchanges. On chain metrics show steady growth in long term holding addresses, signaling a subtle transition from quick flipping toward structured portfolio allocation.

However, risk management remains essential. 📰 Ethereum has laid out a quantum-safe roadmap: the plan is to have a single layer reach execution, consensus, and the data layer by December 2029. This timeline isn’t very generous—protocol teams expect upgrades to start with the Glamsterdam fork in Q4 2026, with subsequent upgrades averaging about 7.2 months apart.

🔥 In the Hegotá upgrade, two proposals have been placed at the core. EIP-7805 in the consensus layer mandates the forced inclusion of public mempool transactions, mainly to address censorship resistance. EIP-8141 in the execution layer, meanwhile, breaks transactions into programmable segments such as verification, Gas payment, and execution.

💡 For ordinary users, EIP-8141 is more intuitive. It lets other accounts pay Gas on a user’s behalf, so users don’t need to hold ETH in advance; they can complete transactions using stablecoins. Token approvals and transactions can also be bundled, and users can change their authorization approach without transferring assets.

Honestly, quantum computing may still sound far off, but user-experience improvements like account abstraction and Gas sponsorship are much closer to users. That said, EIP-8141 is still in draft form, and the details may still change before it’s formally released.

🤔 If in the future you won’t need to keep ETH in your wallet and can pay Gas directly with stablecoins, would you be more willing to move your everyday transactions to Ethereum mainnet?

#以太坊 #ETH #EIP8141 #区块链技术

​To achieve long-term success and peace of mind in the crypto market, managing your risk is far more important than just chasing profits.

​Here are 3 fundamental risk management rules every trader should follow:

​1️⃣ Always Use a Stop Loss (SL):

Never enter a trade without a clear exit plan. A Stop Loss protects your capital from unexpected market crashes and severe losses.

​2️⃣ Control Your FOMO (Fear Of Missing Out):
